en.title: G
en.summary: The letter name is Ge, as in the word Garten.

sections.title: The letter Ge
paragraphs: The letter is called (Ge) /ɡeː/. Its main sound appears in (Garten) /ˈɡaʁtn̩/, which means garden. This letter makes four different sounds.

sections.title: How to say Ge
paragraphs: For the first sound, press the back of your tongue against the soft roof of your mouth and release it with your voice on. For the second, make that same stop with no voice. For the third, hiss air between your tongue and the roof of your mouth. For the fourth, narrow your mouth and buzz your voice through softly. Touch your throat to feel your voice shake on the voiced sounds.

sections.title: Spelling rules for Ge
paragraphs: At the start of a word or syllable, say the voiced sound in (gut) /ɡuːt/. At the end of a word or syllable, say the voiceless sound in (Tag) /taːk/ or (Berg) /bɛʁk/. In the word ending ig, make the soft hiss heard in (könig) /ˈkøːnɪç/ or (richtig) /ˈʁɪçtɪç/. In words borrowed from French, make the buzzing sound heard in (Garage) /ɡaˈʁaːʒə/ or (Genie) /ʒeˈniː/.

sections.title: Mistakes to avoid
paragraphs: Do not make a hard stop at the end of words that end in ig. Avoid saying the hard sound from pig, and make a soft hiss instead. In words like tag, do not keep your voice on at the end as in bag. Turn your voice off so the ending sounds like tack.
